host.title: IP Address or Hostname
host.description: Local IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.100) or hostname of the NAS.

mac.title: MAC Address (for WOL)
mac.description: MAC address used for Wake-on-LAN. Optional — if omitted, power-on will not be available.

port.title: SSH Port
port.description: SSH port on the target machine.

password.title: SSH Password
password.description: SSH password. Required if privateKeyPath is not set. Both may be supplied; private key takes priority.

privateKeyPath.title: SSH Private Key Path
privateKeyPath.description: Absolute path to an SSH private key file. Recommended over password auth.

passphrase.title: Private Key Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

shutdownCommand.title: Shutdown Command
shutdownCommand.description: Command run over SSH to shut down the NAS. Only use trusted values — it is executed directly on the NAS without sanitization.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to check power state via SSH port check. Minimum 5s.

wolVerifyDelay.title: WOL Verify Delay (seconds)
wolVerifyDelay.description: Duration in seconds of the boot verification window after WOL. The plugin retries every 5s within this window — increase for slow-booting hardware.

shutdownCooldownDelay.title: Shutdown Cooldown Delay (seconds)
shutdownCooldownDelay.description: Seconds to suppress polling after a shutdown command to prevent the switch flickering back to ON. Cancelled immediately if the user toggles the switch again.

wolBroadcastAddress.title: WOL Broadcast Address
wolBroadcastAddress.description: Broadcast address for WOL magic packet. Change if your NAS is on a different VLAN or subnet.

knownHostsPath.title: Known Hosts File Path
knownHostsPath.description: Path to store verified SSH host fingerprints. Defaults to $HOMEBRIDGE_USER_STORAGE_PATH/nas-power-known-hosts.

execTimeout.title: SSH Exec Timeout (seconds)
execTimeout.description: How long to wait for the SSH shutdown command to complete before treating it as a timeout. Default 30s matches the internal constant. Increase for slow-shutting hardware.

uuidOverride.title: UUID Override
uuidOverride.description: Advanced: manually specify the seed string for this device's HomeKit UUID. Use when you need a stable UUID independent of MAC address or name/host — for example, to rename a device without losing HomeKit history.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Shown in HomeKit accessory info. Defaults to 'NAS'.

model.title: Model
model.description: Shown in HomeKit accessory info. Defaults to 'NAS'.

firmwareRevision.title: Firmware Revision
firmwareRevision.description: Optional firmware version shown in HomeKit accessory info.

hardwareRevision.title: Hardware Revision
hardwareRevision.description: Optional hardware version shown in HomeKit accessory info.
